d: Counting for 28 Legislative Council seats is underway across Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra and Karnataka, but the process has been accompanied by controversy in Patna and Gorakhpur. In Patna, a bundle of files being carried out of the counting centre triggered an argument, with people demanding to inspect the documents. An Election Commission official later clarified that the files contained presiding officers’ diaries, not Form 16 as alleged.
